subject: Invoice delivery during portal enrollment — temporary email copies & VAT tag
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lina Johnson <lina.johnson@borealishealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery during portal enrollment — temporary email copies & VAT tag
Attachments: sample_invoice_2026-06.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Lina,

Thanks for walking through the portal enrollment earlier. Quick follow-up from our side — the technical rollout for Borealis into the Redwood Billing Portal is locked to 2026-08-01 (customer-side SSO & testing window). Until then we can’t finish the portal activation.

To avoid missing invoice delivery in July, can we do a temporary arrangement:
- Redwood will send monthly PDF invoices to procurement@borealishealth.com (single-CC to procurement).
- We’ll include a billing reference RNW-ACC-9284 on each invoice and include the PO number when you provide it.
- We’ll tag invoices with VAT metadata. Please confirm whether Borealis requires an explicit "reverse-charge" VAT note on the invoice or full VAT line items.

Attached is a sample invoice (sample_invoice_2026-06.pdf) showing the fields we’ll include. Once your portal enrollment is complete we’ll stop the email push and move invoices to the portal only (we’ll give 7 days notice).

Can you confirm: preferred delivery address (procurement@borealishealth.com is fine?), PO number format, and VAT treatment?

Thanks — I’ll loop Finance and Ops to implement the temporary feed.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Lina Johnson <lina.johnson@borealishealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@borealishealth.com
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 14:03:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery during portal enrollment — temporary email copies & VAT tag

Diego,

Thanks — procurement@borealishealth.com is correct for invoices in the interim. A few clarifications from our AP team:

- We prefer a consolidated monthly statement (one PDF with line-item invoices) but will accept single invoice PDFs if easier.
- PO numbers: our PO format is PO-##### (e.g., PO-99281). Please include a visible "PO" field.
- VAT: Borealis Health (EU subsidiary) operates under reverse-charge for services. Please include a clear line on the invoice that reads: "VAT: Reverse-charge — EU VAT provided by customer" and include our VAT ID below. I will attach the VAT cert.
- Payments: we pay via bank transfer (SEPA). Can you provide your bank remit and confirm SEPA details on the invoice?

I attached the VAT registration PDF for reference (vat_cert_borealis.pdf). If you can send a revised sample that includes the reverse-charge line and a visible PO field, procurement will sign off faster.

Best,
Lina Johnson
Head of Procurement
Borealis Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery during portal enrollment — temporary email copies & VAT tag
Attachments: einvoice_schema_v2.xml (text/xml)

Diego / Connor,

Thanks — I will take ownership of the temporary invoice formatting. Action items I’ll handle:
1) Update invoice template to include: RNW-ACC-9284 billing reference, a dedicated "PO" field, and a VAT note exactly as requested: "VAT: Reverse-charge — EU VAT provided by customer (Customer VAT ID: {id})".
2) Add a visible "Remit to (SEPA)" section with our bank account details and IBAN.
3) Produce either (A) consolidated monthly statement PDF or (B) individual PDFs depending on what Connor can deliver quickly; preference is single consolidated PDF if it doesn’t add ops risk.

Connor — I attached our e-invoice schema and mapping rules (einvoice_schema_v2.xml). Can you confirm the nightly push will produce a single consolidated PDF by the end of month and include the attached XML metadata payload alongside? If we can stamp the XML with the PO and VAT tag, that will satisfy AP.

I will not cut the portal enrollment — that stays on the 2026-08-01 target. Once live we will inform Borealis and deprecate the email stream after 7 days.

Kimberly Park
Billing Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery during portal enrollment — temporary email copies & VAT tag

All,

I can set up a nightly job to bundle that month’s invoices into a single consolidated PDF and push to procurement@borealishealth.com each night during the pilot. Planned schedule: first consolidated push will be on 2026-07-31 at 02:00 UTC (so AP sees the July statement on 31st).

Notes / open items:
- I’ll include the XML metadata file alongside the PDF in the outgoing package (einvoice_schema_v2.xml mapping applied).
- Need final VAT ID from Borealis (Lina attached the cert — thanks).
- Please confirm SEPA remit details we should print on the invoice (IBAN / BIC). Finance@redwood.com, please confirm the IBAN that should appear.

If procurement prefers individual PDFs instead of a consolidated statement, let me know by EOD Wed 2026-07-14. Otherwise I’ll proceed with consolidated push.

Connor O'Brien
Revenue Ops Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Lina Johnson <lina.johnson@borealishealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Diego / Kimberly / Connor,

Thanks — consolidated PDF is fine, please proceed with the 2026-07-31 consolidated push. Our PO for the July engagement will be PO-99281; please include it in the file names and the XML metadata.

VAT ID: EU123456789 (as shown on the attached certificate). SEPA: we will pay by SEPA to your IBAN once you include it on the invoice. Procurement has no problem with the reverse-charge line you suggested.

If you can send a quick updated sample (with reverse-charge note, PO field, and remit IBAN), I will confirm sign-off and that will speed July payment.

Regards,
Lina Johnson
Head of Procurement
Borealis Health
